subject: grey heron
title: The Patient Bird at Your Pond Swallows Rats and Ducklings Whole

scenes.text: That still, patient bird by the river is a far bigger killer than it looks.
Grey herons stand a meter tall and are famous for fish.
But one Scottish study found ducklings were a fifth of everything they caught.
They also take water voles, moles and brown rats.
It stabs with its beak until the prey stops moving, dunks it in water, then swallows it head-first.
No chewing. One big rat, gone in a single gulp.

description:
Grey herons are known for fishing, but they also eat ducklings, water voles, moles and brown rats.
At Loch Leven in Scotland, birds (mostly ducklings) made up about 21% of prey items. The heron stabs its prey, dunks it, and swallows it whole, head-first.
Have you ever watched a heron hunt?
first_comment: Herons have also been seen swallowing whole sand martins. Would you keep ducks near a heron pond?
